title: PhysioStudy Chapter 2 High-Yield Cell Function Exam

questions.question_en: What basic functions are shared by all cells?
questions.answer_en: Membrane transport, signal transduction, and bioelectricity
questions.analysis_zh: 本章核心是细胞的普遍功能：物质跨膜转运、信号转导和生物电现象。

questions.question_en: According to the fluid mosaic model, what forms the basic framework of the cell membrane?
questions.analysis_zh: 液态镶嵌模型认为脂质双层构成膜的基本骨架，蛋白质镶嵌其中。

questions.question_en: Which molecules can easily pass through the hydrophobic region of the lipid bilayer by simple diffusion?
questions.analysis_zh: 脂溶性小分子容易穿过膜内部疏水区；葡萄糖、氨基酸和带电离子不能自由通过。

questions.question_en: Which membrane components mainly determine the functional activities of the cell membrane?
questions.analysis_zh: 膜的转运、受体、离子泵、通道等功能主要由膜蛋白完成。

questions.question_en: What is simple diffusion across the cell membrane?
questions.answer_en: Passive movement down a concentration gradient
questions.analysis_zh: 单纯扩散不需要载体、不耗能，物质从高浓度侧向低浓度侧移动。

questions.question_en: What is facilitated diffusion?
questions.answer_en: Passive transport mediated by membrane proteins
questions.analysis_zh: 易化扩散依赖通道或载体，但仍顺浓度梯度或电位梯度转运，不直接消耗ATP。

questions.question_en: What are the two major basic properties of ion channels?
questions.analysis_zh: 离子通道的重要特征是选择性通透特定离子，并可受刺激控制开放或关闭。

questions.question_en: Which type of ion channel is mainly responsible for generating action potentials in nerves and muscles?
questions.analysis_zh: 电压门控通道受膜电位变化调控，是神经和肌肉产生动作电位的基本机制。

questions.question_en: Which ligand-gated channel is found on the skeletal muscle end-plate membrane?
questions.analysis_zh: 骨骼肌终板膜上的N2型ACh受体是化学门控阳离子通道，主要引起Na+内流。

questions.question_en: Which mammalian membrane protein mediates mechanical force sensation?
questions.analysis_zh: Piezo蛋白是机械门控通道，可感受牵张、压迫等机械刺激。

questions.question_en: Which TRP channel can be activated by heat above 42°C, acidic pH, and capsaicin?
questions.analysis_zh: TRPV1兼具温度门控和化学门控特性，是热痛和辣椒素刺激的重要感受通道。

questions.question_en: Which membrane protein forms highly permeable water channels?
questions.analysis_zh: 水通道蛋白AQP可使水快速跨膜转运，在红细胞、肾小管和集合管等处很重要。

questions.question_en: What are the main characteristics of carrier-mediated facilitated diffusion?
questions.analysis_zh: 载体转运需与底物结合并构象改变，因此具有结构特异性、饱和现象和竞争性抑制。

questions.question_en: Which glucose transporter is mainly found in skeletal muscle, cardiac muscle, and adipose tissue?
questions.analysis_zh: GLUT4分布于横纹肌和脂肪组织，数量或功能下降可参与胰岛素抵抗。

questions.question_en: What is active transport across the cell membrane?
questions.answer_en: Energy-dependent transport against an electrochemical gradient
questions.analysis_zh: 主动转运依靠细胞代谢供能，使物质逆浓度梯度或电位梯度跨膜转运。

questions.question_en: How many sodium and potassium ions are transported by the Na+-K+ pump per ATP molecule?
questions.analysis_zh: 钠泵每分解1个ATP，将3个Na+泵出细胞，同时将2个K+泵入细胞。

questions.question_en: Why is the Na+-K+ pump considered electrogenic?
questions.answer_en: It moves one net positive charge outward
questions.analysis_zh: 每个转运周期净移出1个正电荷，使膜内负值增大，具有生电效应。

questions.question_en: What is the most important direct effect of the Na+-K+ pump?
questions.analysis_zh: 钠泵维持细胞内高K+、细胞外高Na+，这是静息电位、动作电位和继发性主动转运的基础。

questions.question_en: Which drug can inhibit the Na+-K+ pump?
questions.analysis_zh: 哇巴因可与钠泵结合并抑制其活动。

questions.question_en: What is the main function of calcium pumps such as PMCA and SERCA?
questions.analysis_zh: 钙泵将Ca2+转运出胞质或回收到肌质网/内质网，使胞质Ca2+维持低水平。

questions.question_en: Which proton pump is inhibited by omeprazole to reduce gastric acid secretion?
questions.analysis_zh: 胃壁细胞H+-K+-ATP酶负责胃酸分泌，奥美拉唑抑制该质子泵。

questions.question_en: What energy source directly drives secondary active transport?
questions.analysis_zh: 继发性主动转运不直接水解ATP，而利用Na+或H+顺梯度扩散释放的势能。

questions.question_en: Which transporter mediates intestinal glucose absorption and renal tubular glucose reabsorption together with sodium?
questions.analysis_zh: 葡萄糖在小肠和近端肾小管上皮细胞中常通过Na+-葡萄糖同向转运进入细胞。

questions.question_en: Which antiporter helps remove Ca2+ from cardiomyocytes after excitation-contraction coupling?
questions.analysis_zh: Na+-Ca2+交换体利用Na+内流的势能，将细胞内Ca2+逆浓度梯度排出。

questions.question_en: What type of transport moves large molecules and particles by vesicle formation?
questions.analysis_zh: 大分子和颗粒物质通过膜包裹、融合和离断形成囊泡完成转运。

questions.question_en: Which endocytic mechanism allows selective uptake of LDL into cells?
questions.analysis_zh: LDL主要经LDL受体介导入胞；受体缺乏或LDL过高可导致血浆LDL升高。

questions.question_en: What is cellular signal transduction?
questions.answer_en: Conversion and transmission of biological information
questions.analysis_zh: 信号转导是细胞间或细胞内生物学信息的转换、传递并产生效应的过程。

questions.question_en: What are the main membrane receptor pathways for signal transduction?
questions.answer_en: Ion channel, GPCR, enzyme-linked, and recruitment receptor pathways
questions.analysis_zh: 膜受体介导的主要通路包括离子通道型受体、G蛋白耦联受体、酶联型受体和招募型受体。

questions.question_en: Why is ion channel receptor signaling faster than GPCR signaling?
questions.analysis_zh: 离子通道型受体开放后迅速改变膜电位，而GPCR需多级信号分子中继。

questions.question_en: What structural feature is typical of G protein-coupled receptors?
questions.analysis_zh: GPCR又称七次跨膜受体，配体结合后通过构象改变激活G蛋白。

questions.question_en: In GPCR signaling, what is the active nucleotide-bound state of a G protein?
questions.analysis_zh: G蛋白结合GDP时失活，结合GTP时激活，起分子开关作用。

questions.question_en: Which second messenger is produced by adenylyl cyclase in the GPCR pathway?
questions.analysis_zh: AC催化生成cAMP；Gs激活AC升高cAMP，Gi抑制AC降低cAMP。

questions.question_en: Which protein kinase is mainly activated by cAMP?
questions.analysis_zh: cAMP多数效应通过激活蛋白激酶A完成，进而磷酸化靶蛋白。

questions.question_en: Which two second messengers are produced when PLC hydrolyzes PIP2?
questions.analysis_zh: PLC分解PIP2生成IP3和DG；IP3促使胞内钙库释放Ca2+，DG激活PKC。

questions.question_en: Which intracellular protein is the most important calcium-binding protein in Ca2+ signaling?
questions.analysis_zh: Ca2+与钙调蛋白CaM结合形成复合物，可激活CaMK、钙调磷酸酶等。

questions.question_en: Which receptor type commonly mediates growth factor signaling through tyrosine phosphorylation?
questions.analysis_zh: 酪氨酸激酶受体被生长因子激活后，使下游蛋白酪氨酸残基磷酸化。

questions.question_en: How do nuclear receptors usually produce their cellular effects?
questions.analysis_zh: 类固醇激素、甲状腺激素等脂溶性配体进入细胞后结合核受体，调控靶基因转录。

questions.question_en: What is the resting membrane potential?
questions.analysis_zh: 静息电位是细胞静息状态下膜内外存在的电位差，通常表现为内负外正。

questions.question_en: Which ion is mainly responsible for generating the resting membrane potential?
questions.analysis_zh: 静息时膜对K+通透性最高，K+外流形成的扩散电位是静息电位的主要来源。

questions.question_en: What happens to the resting membrane potential when extracellular K+ concentration increases?
questions.analysis_zh: 细胞外K+升高使K+平衡电位负值减小，静息电位随之去极化。

questions.question_en: What is an action potential?
questions.analysis_zh: 动作电位是在静息电位基础上由有效刺激触发、可向远处传播的快速膜电位波动。

questions.question_en: What are the three major features of action potentials?
questions.answer_en: All-or-none, nondecremental propagation, and pulse-like firing
questions.analysis_zh: 动作电位一旦产生幅度固定，可不衰减传播，并以一个个分离脉冲形式出现。

questions.question_en: Which ion current mainly causes the rapid depolarizing phase of a typical nerve action potential?
questions.analysis_zh: 电压门控Na+通道开放，Na+快速内流，引起动作电位升支。

questions.question_en: Which ion current mainly contributes to repolarization of a typical nerve action potential?
questions.analysis_zh: Na+通道失活和K+通道开放使K+外流增强，共同导致复极化。

questions.question_en: What is the threshold potential?
questions.answer_en: Membrane potential that triggers regenerative depolarization
questions.analysis_zh: 阈电位是刚好启动膜去极化与Na+电导正反馈的临界膜电位。

questions.question_en: Why does low extracellular Ca2+ increase cellular excitability?
questions.analysis_zh: 细胞外Ca2+降低使钠通道较易激活，阈电位下移，细胞兴奋性升高，可导致低钙惊厥。

questions.question_en: What is the absolute refractory period?
questions.answer_en: Period when no new action potential can occur
questions.analysis_zh: 绝对不应期内电压门控Na+或Ca2+通道已激活或失活，无论刺激多强都不能再次兴奋。

questions.question_en: What is saltatory conduction?
questions.answer_en: Action potential jumping between nodes of Ranvier
questions.analysis_zh: 有髓神经纤维动作电位只在郎飞结产生，可显著提高传导速度并减少能量消耗。

questions.question_en: Which cell junction allows direct electrical spread between adjacent cells?
questions.analysis_zh: 缝隙连接由连接蛋白形成跨细胞孔道，可使离子和小分子通过，是心肌电传导的重要结构基础。

questions.question_en: What are the main features of local potentials?
questions.analysis_zh: 局部电位不具有全或无特点，可随距离衰减，无不应期，并可发生时间总和和空间总和。
